title: Pull-String Fireworks
about: A harmless backstage prank that became one of the unforgettable stories from Arts-In dorm life.
description: This track tells the story of a lighthearted prank involving pull-string fireworks hidden around the dorms during State Arts-In. After sleepless nights caused by the livestock campers, a few carefully planned paper snaps created surprise, laughter, and plenty of confusion without causing any harm. It's a celebration of the harmless mischief, friendships, and unforgettable memories that often become the stories people remember most.
